messages.subject: calculateDiffMeth
parts:
Dear All,

I write because I am currently running MethylKit package on RRBS data (bismarkcytosine report) and I am encountering some problems with calculateDiffMeth function.

I had no problem in loading my files (2 controls and 2 treatments) and to create a meth object with methRead.
Now, I am trying to find my DMR and therefore I launched the following command on my meth object:

> myDiff=calculateDiffMeth(meth, mc.cores=1)

two groups detected:
will calculate methylation difference as the difference of
treatment (group: 1) - control (group: 0)

and then... nothing.. R keeps on computing for ages (literally hours) and I do not have yet any result out from this command..

Out of frustration, at a certain point I stopped the process and I got the following warnings:

Warning messages:
1: glm.fit: fitted probabilities numerically 0 or 1 occurred 
2: glm.fit: fitted probabilities numerically 0 or 1 occurred 
3: glm.fit: fitted probabilities numerically 0 or 1 occurred 
4: glm.fit: fitted probabilities numerically 0 or 1 occurred 
5: glm.fit: fitted probabilities numerically 0 or 1 occurred 
6: glm.fit: fitted probabilities numerically 0 or 1 occurred



Therefore I just would like to understand:

1. is the calculateDiffMeth running properly?

2. I am currently waiting for a new machine (hopefully way more powerful than the one that I have now) however I was hoping to be able to do some analysis with R on my data before to get it.. so could my problem be due to "the power" of my current PC? Just to know if eventually I could consider to make an overnight DMR calculation and hope to get finally something out of it or if there is something wrong with my dataset from the begin with.

Currently, I am running the analysis on a i7 dual core and in parallel on a macBook i5 4core to try to speed up since I have multiple conditions and samples to be tested from the RRBS experiment performed.

I really thank in advance anyone that could give any hints!

Have a nice day,

Cristina
